receipt.jitPolicy: Tiered compilation disabled; fully optimized JIT before measurement
receipt.boundary: Warm memory horizontal flip with output pixel allocation, complete materialization and release. Managed public ImageBuffer call, including admission/metadata; native public FFmpeg hflip graph with reused graph/source/frame wrappers and fresh non-aliasing pixel result. Native samples use worker monotonic elapsed time, not caller protocol duration. No codec or pixel/depth conversion. Native nativeBefore/nativeAfter bracket the managed BenchmarkDotNet iterations. Exact independent placement includes zero-alpha hidden RGB.

receipt.name: WarmNormalOrientation
receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA16 raster with Normal orientation copied into an independent owned 513x259 raster at the same depth. Complete public AutoOrient, admission, allocation, full materialization and disposal. Native public FFmpeg null graph emits a shared view; av_frame_get_buffer plus av_frame_copy allocates and materializes an independent raster inside every operation before release. Graph/source/frame wrappers are reused. Native padded rows exposed directly; one necessary owned copy, no redundant packing copy. Exact complete channel bytes, alpha and hidden RGB; no output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this original raster is measured.
